title: Descent and an exact presentation of lattice classes
statement: For a finite p-adic coefficient extension and any sheaf L of rational coefficient modules on X_proet [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], there exist a set-valued sheaf F and surjections c_U from integral lattice pairs to its sections. Their exact kernel relation is intertwining integral isomorphism, and restriction is characterized by the embedded images on all slice objects [lem-weil-pbc-lattice-pair-image-classification]. No local-freeness assumption on L is required for this presentation.

proof.text: Use representable embedded image families. Separatedness and effective descent make them a sheaf; their class maps are surjective, image classification gives their kernel, and restriction is precomposition on slices.
